title: Childhood fall from a garage roof softened by warmth

tellings.quote: one of the branches snapped and I fell and I fell like 25 ft.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to talk with aliens, says that as a child a branch snapped under him and he fell about 25 feet near the garage roof, and the fall was softened by a feeling of warmth. He tells Michels this about himself, as an early sign that something was looking after him.
